$comment: Allowlist for scripts/check-model-ids.mjs — model ids the canary must NOT fail on.
An entry here means: 'this id is knowingly-unreachable configuration, and we have
decided not to fix it today.' It does NOT mean the id is harmless. A dead id sitting
in dead code is still a landmine for whoever revives that code, which is exactly why
this is a checked-in file with a mandatory per-entry `reason` rather than a silent
skip inside the script. Adding an entry is a reviewable diff hunk; that diff IS the
The canary still PROBES allowlisted ids and still prints their real status — it just
does not exit non-zero on them. An allowlisted id that is DEAD prints as a ::warning::
every run so it stays visible.
`reason` must be >= 20 characters. An unexplained entry is rejected (exit 2).
TO REMOVE AN ENTRY (the direction that should be common): fix or delete the dead
config, then delete the entry in the same PR. The canary prints a 'ratchet
opportunity' hint when an allowlisted id is no longer referenced anywhere.
